args.text: Start a note to June about the PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, and Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. Post the bullets here.

args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- Please treat 'Covey — Late Arrivals' as the Pellow Home Living account, and check whether the saved report needs its label updated.

Sent on behalf of Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team).
